comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Prosperity of Ancient Egypt Memorial Album, this is a ship decoration for back left/right, created using Sophia points and Transmutation Alchemy. Recipe is as follows:

Base item: The Rosetta Stone (ornament)
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points: 250
The Sun's Gemstone x1
Boulders x40
Terra Extract x10

Chance of success: 40%

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/ItemBoost
Thanks to MarcoS for noticing I linked the wrong item.
